deduplication.method: Metadata-level semantic screen against all tool IDs and descriptions in the baseline and all four contribution catalogs; parent implementation-level dedup review remains required.
deduplication.limitations: No new candidate is asserted accepted or deployable from this research. Internal candidate cross-references are explicitly proposed, not existing registry IDs.

common_safety_scope.future_inputs: Explicit bounded JSON arrays/tables and local measured structures only; never executable MSON @class/@module payloads.

operations.scientific_task: Identify crystal space group, Wyckoff-site equivalence and symmetry operations from an explicit periodic atomic structure.
operations.scientific_scope: Atomic crystallographic symmetry, not outcrop orientation analysis. Report standard setting and tolerance; species labels must preserve chemistry.
input_constraints: 3x3 nonsingular finite lattice with positive volume; 1..128 sites
Fractional coordinates and positive species codes aligned; no coincident different species
Explicit 1e-8..1e-2 angstrom symmetry tolerance; disorder/partial occupancy not inferred

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC simple cubic a=4 angstrom with one atom at fractional [0,0,0].
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: The full octahedral group has 24 proper and 24 improper operations; a primitive cubic monatomic lattice has Pm-3m symmetry.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Singular lattice, nonfinite coordinates or overlapping incompatible species must fail, not return a guessed space group.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Those tools analyze geological pole/lineation fabrics. This searches lattice translations and atomic-site symmetry; no existing crystal space-group task was found.
risks: Symmetry is tolerance-dependent; noisy structural measurements may admit multiple interpretations.
Compiled wheel/ABI acceptance pending. Magnetic symmetry is not split into another counted tool.

operations.scientific_task: Predict a kinematic powder X-ray diffraction pattern from a supplied crystal structure.
operations.scientific_scope: Calculate Bragg peak positions, multiplicities and relative intensities for an explicit atomic model. Not phase identification or Rietveld refinement.
input_constraints: 1..128 fully occupied sites; finite positive lattice volume and wavelength
Bound two_theta range to 0..150 degrees; no automatic symmetry refinement
No hidden anisotropic U_cif site properties; any displacement model must be explicit in a future schema

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC monatomic simple-cubic Si model, a=4 angstrom, wavelength=1 angstrom; not an assertion that elemental Si is simple cubic.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: Bragg law 2d sin(theta)=lambda and cubic d100=a independently determine the first allowed reflection. Extend acceptance with BCC systematic absences and occupancy/intensity sum checks.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Zero wavelength, invalid occupancy, singular cell or conflicting isotropic/anisotropic displacement models must fail.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing tools compare reflectance spectra with references. This predicts diffraction from periodic atomic positions and scattering factors, a different measurement and physical model.
risks: Kinematic powder model omits preferred orientation, instrument broadening and many experimental effects.
2026.10.24 has explicit anisotropic-displacement behavior changes; do not silently use defaults.

operations.scientific_task: Recalculate measured mineral oxide chemistry to charge-labelled cations per explicit oxygen formula unit.
operations.scientific_scope: Electron-microprobe/mineral formula audit on an explicitly stated oxygen basis. No crystallographic site allocation, Fe-redox inference or normative mineral prediction.
input_constraints: One complete finite oxide composition per upstream call; batch handling must call the same kernel per sample
Simple oxides only; positive total; explicit oxygen basis 1..32
FeO/Fe2O3 are caller-specified measurements; absent measurements are not filled or inferred

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC stoichiometric forsterite chemistry, exactly 2 mol MgO plus 1 mol SiO2, expressed as mass percentages using independently tabulated atomic masses; oxygen basis 4.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: Mg2SiO4 atom counting and charge neutrality require 2 Mg, 1 Si and 4 O regardless of uniform mass scaling.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Unknown/mixed unsupported species, negative oxide values, missing redox provenance or nonpositive oxygen basis must fail.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Oxide-moles conversion stops at mol/100g; this fixes a mineral oxygen basis and yields ionic formula proportions. Blocked CIPW allocates normative phases and is not reused.
risks: The upstream function supports a single Series-like sample, not general multi-row DataFrames.
Preserve measured iron species and explicitly set oxygen_constrained=True; do not rely on automatic iron heuristics.

operations.scientific_task: Balance a supplied mineral reaction and report stoichiometric coefficients and element residuals.
operations.scientific_scope: Conservation-law balancing of user-declared mineral reactants/products. Does not infer a reaction pathway, equilibrium state or kinetic rate.
input_constraints: 2..12 supplied mineral formulae, no unknown elements or executable deserialization
Require unambiguous species-side assignment; report any upstream side changes rather than silently accepting them
Normalize to one caller-selected input species from the fixed list; no arbitrary function selection

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC forsterite + quartz -> enstatite: Mg2SiO4 + SiO2 -> MgSiO3.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: Direct counting gives the unique primitive integer balance [1,1,2].
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: An impossible reaction with an element present on only one side, or an underdetermined family without a declared convention, must not be presented as a unique reaction.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Neither converts a list of mineral species into a balanced reaction. Chemical unmixing estimates coefficients against observed compositions rather than balancing a declared transformation.
risks: The general upstream solver may move species across sides; a bounded adapter must make that explicit.
No thermodynamic favorability follows from balance alone.

operations.scientific_task: Calculate phase decomposition and energy above the compositional convex hull from explicit consistent phase energies.
operations.scientific_scope: Closed-system thermodynamic stability relative to the supplied finite phase set. No online Materials Project database, missing phase invention or mineral mode estimation from assays.
input_constraints: At most 4 elements and 64 phase entries, with all required elemental reference entries
All energies must use one temperature/pressure/reference convention and explicit formula normalization
Do not mix uncorrected DFT, experimental free energies or different reference states silently

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC Li and O elemental entries at 0 eV/atom; stable LiO at -2 eV per LiO formula; a second LiO polymorph at 0 eV per formula.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: The stable LiO tie-point is -1 eV/atom. At identical composition the energy difference is exactly 1 eV/atom.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Missing elemental references, inconsistent units or unknown formula elements must fail.

operations.distinct_from_existing: This selects energetically stable combinations from supplied phase energies; unmixing fits composition and CIPW follows a normative allocation sequence. No blocked CIPW code is involved.
risks: Only relative to supplied entries; omitted stable phases can change every conclusion.
Coexistence at finite T needs free energies, not merely static energies.

operations.scientific_task: Determine periodic atomic coordination environments and neighbor identities in a mineral structural model.
operations.scientific_scope: Neighbor topology and coordination around specified crystallographic sites. Not a grain/fabric orientation tensor or a generic spatial-nearest-point query.
input_constraints: At most 128 sites; fully periodic finite structure and explicit site selection
State geometric versus chemistry-weighted convention once per workflow; do not count different site axes/species as tools
No oxidation-state inference unless separately declared; cap initial search radius

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC ideal rock-salt NaCl, conventional cubic a=5.64 angstrom, geometric CrystalNN settings.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: Each site has six Cartesian nearest neighbors at plus/minus a/2 along three axes.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Coincident atoms, invalid site index, singular cells and unsupported disorder must fail.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Atomic periodic images and coordination weights are not bulk foliation-lineation tensors or nearest geographic feature lookup.
risks: Chemical weights are model assumptions, not observed bonds.
local_env imports ruamel.yaml directly; dependency freeze must include it.

operations.scientific_task: Infer charge-balanced oxidation-state assignments using bond-valence evidence from a supplied mineral structure.
operations.scientific_scope: Explicitly model-inferred oxidation states for structural quality control. Never relabel them as measured iron speciation or assay chemistry.
input_constraints: At most 64 ordered atomic sites and 10000 enumerated assignments
Elements must have upstream parameter-table coverage; report unsupported species
Neutral input chemical model and explicit symmetry/distance tolerances

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC ideal periclase MgO rock-salt cell a=4.21 angstrom.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: Independent chemical valence and charge neutrality for stoichiometric MgO give Mg2+ and O2-; compare all equivalent sites, not just one.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Unsupported element parameters or failure to find a neutral assignment must return an explicit failure, not guessed zeros.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Baseline oxide conversion preserves supplied oxidation species. This uses crystal bond distances to infer a labelled model assignment; formula normalization only rescales explicitly measured species.
risks: Empirical/probabilistic assignment may be ambiguous or wrong for unusual minerals.
Do not use as automatic correction of measured FeO/Fe2O3.

operations.scientific_task: Match periodic mineral structures across site permutations, origin shifts and alternative cells.
operations.scientific_scope: Test structural equivalence with explicit species identity and normalized RMS displacement. Not a proof that two specimens are the same mineral phase.
input_constraints: At most 128 sites per model; bound supercell search or disable it
Require explicit species comparison; no anonymous element substitutions
Fix length/angle/site tolerances; preserve scale rather than allowing arbitrary density changes

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC rock-salt model and an identical model with atom order permuted and all fractional positions shifted by [1/4,1/4,1/4] modulo one.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: A global translation and relabelling preserve all periodic pair separations and species.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Replacing a chemical species must not match under the fixed SpeciesComparator; mismatches are a valid result, not an exception hidden as success.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Image phase registration finds raster translation. This compares 3D periodic atomic species under cell reduction, origins and site permutations.
risks: Tolerance-dependent and combinatorial; arbitrary supercell searches can grow rapidly.
Report normalized RMS units honestly, not angstroms.

operations.scientific_task: Construct an equilibrium crystal habit from supplied Miller-plane surface energies.
operations.scientific_scope: Surface-energy-controlled equilibrium shape of a single crystal, with face-area fractions and shape factor. Not growth kinetics or observed morphology classification.
input_constraints: 3..32 unique bounded nonzero Miller families with positive finite energies
Conventional lattice supplied explicitly; all energies use one termination/environment convention
Only normalized geometry is physical without a size constraint; do not label raw Wulff volume as angstrom^3

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC cubic lattice with gamma100=1 J/m^2 and gamma110=gamma111=2 J/m^2.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: The {100} planes bound a cube; higher-energy diagonal planes lie outside its edges/corners. Any cube has S/V^(2/3)=6.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Negative surface energies, zero Miller indices or an unbounded/degenerate intersection must fail.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing methods measure supplied image regions or fit a circle to a site polygon; this predicts a crystal habit through surface-energy minimization.
risks: Surface energies are caller evidence, not generated by this tool.
Observed natural habits may be kinetically controlled.

operations.scientific_task: Evaluate neutral 3D-periodic ionic electrostatic energy by Ewald summation.
operations.scientific_scope: Point-charge electrostatic component of a mineral lattice energy. Not a total cohesive energy, force field, elastic model or geophysical field.
input_constraints: At most 128 sites with explicitly assigned finite charges and zero net charge within tolerance
Require all three periodic directions, nonsingular positive-volume lattice and no coincident sites
Bound convergence accuracy and ensure charge origin is caller-supplied, not automatically inferred

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC conventional NaCl cell a=5.64 angstrom, 4 Na+ and 4 Cl-.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: Independent rock-salt Madelung sum gives -4*M*14.3996454784255/(a/2) eV. The integer-lattice Madelung reference must be cited/frozen independently during test authoring, not obtained from EwaldSummation.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Non-3D periodic structures, nonneutral cells in this explicitly neutral model, missing charges or overlaps must fail.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Finite-body gravity and elastic mixture moduli do not compute periodic ionic Coulomb lattice energies.
risks: Does not include short-range repulsion, polarization or electronic energy.
Use the current core release with periodicity fixes; never confuse charged-cell background conventions with neutral lattice energy.

operations.scientific_task: Search bounded coincidence superlattices for two declared mineral surface nets.
operations.scientific_scope: Zur-McGill matching of 2D crystallographic surface lattices for epitaxy/intergrowth hypotheses. Does not establish an observed interface or its energy.
input_constraints: Two noncollinear coplanar vector pairs in a declared common convention
Positive bounded search area <=400 angstrom^2 and output <=64 matches
Fixed mismatch tolerances; no user-selected JIT/kernel/code

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC identical square surface nets with vectors [2,0,0] and [0,2,0] angstrom; bounded search area 16 angstrom^2.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: The primitive 2x2 square nets already coincide, requiring no supercell enlargement or strain.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Collinear vectors, zero/negative areas or resource-exploding searches must fail before enumeration.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Polar decomposition analyzes a supplied deformation; surface-net matching searches discrete crystallographic coincidences and integer supercells.
risks: Combinatorial enumeration and Numba imports need CPU resource limits.
Lattice match alone does not imply favorable interface bonding.

operations.scientific_task: Enumerate symmetry-distinct crystallographic slab terminations for a supplied mineral Miller plane.
operations.scientific_scope: Construct explicit atomistic surfaces and termination stoichiometry for downstream surface chemistry. No DFT, relaxation or inferred reconstruction.
input_constraints: At most 128 bulk sites and 2048 generated slab sites; abs(h,k,l)<=4, not all zero
Explicit slab/vacuum thickness and preservation of chemical species
No automatic repair, symmetrization-induced stoichiometry changes or reconstructions

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC monatomic simple-cubic a=2 angstrom, (001), slab thickness 8 angstrom and vacuum 10 angstrom.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: The primitive (001) surface cell is a square of side 2; four cubic repeats supply four atomic planes at spacing 2. Compare geometry invariantly, not by arbitrary origin.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Zero Miller triplet, nonpositive vacuum or a slab exceeding atom bounds must fail.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Plane intersection gives a line from field planes; Wulff predicts an external equilibrium shape. This builds stoichiometric atomistic terminations and vacuum-separated slabs.
risks: Broken-bond and surface-charge diagnostics depend on explicit chemistry.
Slab generation is not a relaxed or energetically ranked mineral surface.

operations.scientific_task: Reduce a crystal reciprocal-space integration grid to symmetry-inequivalent points and multiplicity weights.
operations.scientific_scope: Symmetry-aware Brillouin-zone sampling preparation for mineral electronic/phonon calculations. Does not run those calculations.
input_constraints: Mesh dimensions 1..32 with total <=32768 points; valid bounded crystal cell
State time-reversal assumption; magnetic states must not silently assume it
Use one gamma-centered workflow; shifts/axes are not separate tools

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC simple cubic monatomic cell with gamma-centered 2x2x2 mesh and time reversal.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: The eight binary grid points partition by number of half-grid components into Gamma/X/M/R orbits with multiplicities 1,3,3,1.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Zero/negative mesh entries, excess total points or singular cell must fail.

operations.distinct_from_existing: No existing task builds crystallographic reciprocal integration weights; neither spectral dimension reduction nor stereonet projection does this.
risks: Only valid under the declared symmetry and time-reversal assumptions.
A mesh is preparation data, not a converged DFT result.

operations.scientific_task: Fit orthogonal rare-earth pattern shape coefficients to explicit normalized log-REE data.
operations.scientific_scope: O'Neill polynomial shape description of REE patterns, with residual/uncertainty interpretation. No duplicate normalization plot or automatic mineralization label.
input_constraints: Fixed O'Neill basis and degree 4; document reference composition and excluded elements
Enough uncensored complete REE measurements; no imputation of detection-limit values
No arbitrary polynomial basis, optimizer callable or tetrad mode presented as extra tools

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC every supplied normalized log-REE value equals 2, with at least eight fitted elements.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: A constant function lies entirely in the degree-zero basis, whose value is one; higher-order coefficients must vanish. Add an independently expanded linear polynomial fixture during acceptance.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Insufficient fitted elements, nonfinite log-values or missing reference provenance must fail.

operations.distinct_from_existing: REEPattern normalizes and plots abundances/Eu anomaly; ILR gives compositional balances. This extracts smooth chemical-pattern shape through an ionic-radius polynomial model.
risks: Basis choice and element exclusion alter coefficient meaning.
Uncertainty interpretation needs measurement errors; no goodness-of-fit equals geological proof.

operations.scientific_task: Classify declared anhydrous volcanic whole-rock chemistry in the fixed Middlemost TAS fields.
operations.scientific_scope: Empirical rock nomenclature from measured silica and total alkalis. Not mineral identification, weathering correction or prediction of tectonic setting.
input_constraints: Caller must attest volcanic, suitable unaltered whole-rock scope and anhydrous normalization
SiO2 and both alkalis must be finite, nonnegative and jointly <=100 wt_percent
Boundary/overlap cases need explicit ambiguity reporting; never nearest-centroid forced naming

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC SiO2=50, Na2O=2, K2O=1 wt_percent.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: On the independently interpreted TAS diagram the point is between silica 45 and 52, below the dividing line y=2+3*(x-45)/7=4.142857 and above zero. It lies strictly inside the subalkalic-basalt polygon.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Negative concentrations, undeclared hydration/normalization or boundary ambiguity must not yield a confident rock label.

operations.distinct_from_existing: CPT lithology uses cone/friction measurements and spectral matching uses reflectance; neither applies volcanic whole-rock chemical nomenclature.
risks: Fixed Middlemost subfields differ from combined Le Maitre fields; report exact convention.
One classification task only; individual named fields are not separate tools.

operations.scientific_task: Calculate mineral neutron scattering-length density, macroscopic cross sections and attenuation from explicit composition and density.
operations.scientific_scope: Predict neutron contrast for mineral/porous-rock experiments using bundled evaluated scattering data. No mineral identification or experimental radiation-safety certification.
input_constraints: Explicit chemical/isotopic formula, positive finite density and thermal/cold-neutron wavelength
All constituent data must exist; unknown cross sections are not zero
Bound formula atom count and wavelength samples; no remote table replacement

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC SiO2 at density 2.65 g/cm^3 and wavelength 1.798 angstrom.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: Independent NIST/Sears bSi=4.1491 fm, bO=5.803 fm and number density rho*NA/M give the quoted SLD. Use 0.1% tolerance because pinned periodictable uses newer 4.15071 and 5.8037 fm values; do not replace the oracle with a call into the same table.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Missing density, unknown isotope/scattering data or invalid wavelength must fail explicitly.

operations.distinct_from_existing: XRD models reciprocal-lattice diffraction from atomic positions; this predicts bulk nuclear scattering/attenuation from composition and density. Fluid PVT does neither.
risks: Nuclear data uncertainty and bound-atom approximation limit agreement with experiments.
Public-domain module plus distribution-specific notices must be retained.

operations.scientific_task: Measure boundary-aware pore chord-length distributions from segmented rock microstructure.
operations.scientific_scope: Line-intercept stereology of an explicitly segmented pore phase. One task accepts a direction; different axes are not counted separately.
input_constraints: Boolean 2D/3D pore mask with isotropic explicit voxel pitch and <=64^3 voxels
Declared direction; positive spacing >=1; edge truncation treatment explicit
Do not infer segmentation or use generic region size as a chord without upstream chord construction

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC 8x8 mask with an interior two-voxel chord at column 2 and four-voxel chord at column 4, both parallel to axis 0; pitch=0.01 m; bins [0.01,0.03,0.05] m.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: Manual line-intercept enumeration yields precisely the two lengths; equal chord counts give equal probability mass.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Nonpositive pitch, unsorted bins, no retained chords or invalid axis must not produce a fabricated distribution.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Region properties describe whole connected image objects; skeletonization gives a medial graph. Chord stereology samples lineal pore lengths with explicit edge censoring.
risks: Edge trimming changes the sampled population and must be reported.
Requires PoreSpy's larger CPU dependency profile; no GPU or rendering path.

operations.scientific_task: Estimate voxel-center local pore-body radii by maximal inscribed spheres and summarize pore-volume radius distribution.
operations.scientific_scope: Local maximal-sphere pore-body size, not access-limited capillary entry radius, a global site-inscribed circle, or a count of connected regions.
input_constraints: Explicit boolean 3D pore segmentation with isotropic pitch and solid boundary padding
At most 32^3 voxels for the initial bounded CPU workflow
Fix the integer-radius voxel-center definition; no unreported conversion to continuum radii or diameters

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC 7x7x7 solid grid with the central 3x3x3 cube marked pore; voxel pitch=1 um; integer radii 1,2; smooth=True.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: The central pore voxel is two center-to-center spacings from the nearest solid. Every one of the 27 pore centers is at distance <=sqrt(3)<2 from that center, so the radius-2 digital sphere covers all pore voxels.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Anisotropic or missing voxel spacing, empty pore masks or an unbounded all-pore image must not receive an unqualified physical radius.

operations.distinct_from_existing: The spatial tool finds one global 2D circle inside a site polygon. This assigns local radii throughout a 3D pore volume; chord lengths instead measure directional line intercepts.
risks: PoreSpy3.2.0 uses integer radii by default; resolution bias and solid/pore interface convention must be explicit.
Volume-weighted pore-body size is not throat size or capillary-pressure distribution.

operations.scientific_task: Simulate access-limited capillary invasion and pressure-saturation response in a segmented pore volume.
operations.scientific_scope: Quasistatic image-based drainage using explicitly supplied pore-entry pressures and inlet/outlet masks. Not a flow-rate solver, forecast or measured saturation replacement.
input_constraints: <=32^3 boolean voxels, explicit pitch, pressure field and <=64 pressure steps
Disjoint inlet/outlet masks within pore space; finite positive pore-entry pressures
No implicit dimensionless 2/dt pressure default; any uninvaded infinity must become a documented status/null in future JSON

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC inlet-connected straight pore channel with entry-pressure field exactly 2000 Pa, no residual phase and no outlet-trapping constraint; applied steps 1000 and 3000 Pa.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: No point is eligible below the common entry threshold; at the next applied step the whole connected channel is accessible. Discrete applied-step pressure must not be misreported as exact entry pressure.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Overlapping inlet/outlet masks, invalid pressure units or nonfinite pore-entry values must fail.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Watershed partitions image basins, patchy-saturation rock models predict elastic response, and DEM filling conditions terrain. None predicts pore-access-limited invasion and trapping.
risks: Finite pressure-step resolution affects reported invasion thresholds.
Static capillary model omits viscous dynamics; supplied pressure fields require physical justification.

operations.scientific_task: Evaluate mineral/ion thermodynamic stability and decomposition energy over explicit Eh-pH conditions.
operations.scientific_scope: Pourbaix stability relative to user-supplied solid/aqueous formation energies and concentrations at the upstream fixed room-temperature convention. Not kinetic dissolution, complete aqueous speciation or a water-quality prediction.
input_constraints: One or two non-H/O components, <=32 entries and <=256 evaluation points
Explicit consistent formation-energy references to H2/O2 and ideal concentration convention
No external database fetch; no arbitrary temperature input because the upstream prefactor is fixed
Serial evaluation only; do not infer absent phases or activity corrections

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC Fe(s) with formation energy 0 and Fe2+(aq) with formation energy +1 eV/Fe at 1 mol/L, with no H/O in either formula.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: Two-electron exchange lowers the ion's free energy by 2E eV; equality is 1-2E=0. At 1 V the ion is lower by 1 eV/Fe. pH has no effect for this deliberately H/O-free analytic fixture.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Missing energy references, nonpositive concentrations or unsupported temperature claims must fail.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Closed-composition hull stability fixes all component amounts; this treats H/O/electrons as open reservoirs and includes ionic concentrations and electrochemical conditions. It is not another phase-hull plotting mode.
risks: Data/reference-state quality dominates validity; incomplete phase sets can mislead.
Multi-element combinations can grow rapidly. Fixed room-temperature/ideal-solution assumptions must remain visible.

operations.scientific_task: Estimate spatial sampling declustering weights and cell-size sensitivity for clustered geological observations.
operations.scientific_scope: Two-dimensional cell declustering of measured samples. Report sample weights and sensitivity, not an ore-resource estimate or an automatically unbiased population mean.

units.coordinates: m in explicit local projected frame
units.weights: dimensionless, upstream sums to sample count

input_constraints: 4..1024 finite paired samples, positive cell sizes, <=32 sizes and <=16 offsets
Bound allocated cell grid to <=1000000 cells before upstream allocation
State the objective as executed: iminmax=1 selects a lower mean despite the conflicting upstream docstring
No imputed values, automatic assay cutoffs or spatial extrapolation

fixed_invocation_plan.kernel_objective_mapping: 1=minimize, 0=maximize according to inspected code; not upstream docstring

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC points (0.1,0.1),(0.2,0.2),(0.3,0.3),(10.1,10.1) m with values [10,10,10,2] ppm; fixed 5 m cells, one origin and ncell=1.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: Three samples share one occupied cell and the fourth occupies a second cell. Equal cell support gives weights 1/6 for each clustered sample and 1/2 for the isolated sample.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: Zero cell size, nonfinite coordinates or excessive allocation must fail before calling the kernel.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Variograms measure spatial dependence; Voronoi builds service polygons; background distance measures chemical departure. None estimates sampling-density declustering weights and cell-size sensitivity.
risks: Immutable source is usable as a research target but __version__=0.0.46 does NOT establish correspondence with PyPI0.0.79.
Underdeclared dependencies, stdout progress and reversed objective documentation require parent review before any wrapper.
Selecting a minimum mean assumes preferential high-value sampling; report sensitivity rather than claiming unbiasedness.

operations.scientific_task: Solve steady pore-space diffusion to estimate effective diffusivity ratio, formation factor and tortuosity.
operations.scientific_scope: Finite-difference transport through segmented connected pores, with explicit directional boundary conditions and convergence checks. Not porosity counting or a geometric shortest-path proxy.
input_constraints: <=32^3 boolean voxels with explicit isotropic pitch and a through-connected pore phase
One declared flow direction per call, not separate tools per axis
Require converged=True and acceptable inlet/outlet flux balance; report trimmed nonpercolating volume
Fixed CPU solver object bound by adapter, never user-supplied code/class

proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.fixture: SYNTHETIC 8x4x4 grid with straight pore channel [:,1:3,1:3], normalized concentration 1 and 0 at the axial ends.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.derivation: Four of sixteen cross-sectional cells conduct in parallel with straight unit-length paths. Fick's law gives D_eff/D_free=area fraction=1/4; tau=porosity/(D_eff/D_free)=1.
proposed_independent_numeric_oracle.negative: No through-connected path, solver nonconvergence or flux imbalance must not return a valid transport result.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Least cost/resistance describe supplied planning networks; soil conductivity uses a constitutive saturation model. This solves a diffusion boundary-value problem on the actual pore phase.
risks: OpenPNM3.6.1 requires scipy>=1.16.2 and pandas>=2.3.2, conflicting with the fixed accepted main profile.
Only a separate parent-controlled CPU environment is a candidate path; no in-place dependency replacement.
PoreSpy accesses OpenPNM solver internals, requiring version-pair acceptance.

excluded_not_counted.reason: Previously blocked operation; not proposed again or counted. Existing immutable-fix research and failures are not rewritten.
Previously blocked fluorapatite scientific defect; not proposed again or counted.

Inspected 1.0.24 computes absolute per-variable differences, multiplies them, then feeds the product to an estimator that squares it. This loses negative cross-dependence and has wrong product units for a signed cross-semivariogram. Not rescued by a positive-correlation example.
excluded_not_counted.independent_rejection_example: For colocated increments +2 ppm and -4 ppm, the cross-semivariogram contribution is -4 ppm^2. Squaring the absolute product instead gives +32 ppm^4.

excluded_not_counted.topic: GSTools CondSRF as exact conditional Gaussian simulation
excluded_not_counted.reason: Inspected 1.7.0 returns kriging mean plus an unconditional field multiplied by pointwise standard-deviation factors. This can match marginal variances and conditioning values but does not generally equal the full Gaussian conditional joint covariance. Not proposed under an exact conditional-simulation claim.
excluded_not_counted.independent_rejection_example: For unit exponential covariance, one exact observation at x=0, and target points x=1 and -1, true conditional cross covariance is exp(-2)-exp(-1)^2=0. The inspected pointwise-scaling construction gives (1-exp(-2))*exp(-2)>0.

excluded_not_counted.topic: Binary pore two-point correlation as an extra tool
excluded_not_counted.reason: Conservatively omitted because it is algebraically close to the accepted GLCM/co-occurrence family. A new implementation should not be counted without stronger parent-level distinctness review.

excluded_not_counted.topic: Magnetic symmetry, individual crystal axes, alternative classifiers and repeated methods
excluded_not_counted.reason: Not split into additional counted candidates. No parameter-family or axis padding.

excluded_not_counted.topic: More kriging, elastic mixtures, compositional transforms and generic drill-log resampling
